correctness.rationale: The normalized cosine moment is evaluated exactly by the beta integral. Strict monotonicity of C_q follows from strict L^q-norm monotonicity for the nonconstant random variable |cos t| on the normalized circle; since q=p/(p-1) decreases with p, the radius increases strictly. The p→1 expansion follows from the gamma-ratio asymptotic and gives the logarithmic term after taking the qth root. The p→∞ coefficient follows from the exact digamma values at 1 and 3/2. All endpoint constants and special values are consistent with the exact formula.
